request.summary: Create a read-only factory safety results dashboard paired with the Factory Safety Questionnaire and driven by its Results table.
request.audience: Safety leads and shift supervisors monitoring completion and pass performance on a shared landscape display.
request.primaryGoal: Turn bounded raw questionnaire result rows into an immediate operational overview without introducing a second write path or duplicated statistics datasource.

assumptions: The packaged data is fictional and representative; no real employee identity or customer data is included.
The dashboard reads the questionnaire Results table and computes all aggregate metrics locally.
The Results table remains the source of truth; higher-volume aggregation belongs in a future backend or automation workflow.

surfaceStrategy.rationale: The dashboard is designed for Full HD control-room displays and smaller 16:9 landscape status screens.

ownership.rationale: The paired questionnaire owns result collection while this dashboard reads the same customer-managed table.
Operators control public labels, pass policy, recent-row density, and identity visibility without rebuilding.
Coordinated themes are safe defaults and the flattened Custom controls expose the complete semantic palette.
Normalization and aggregate calculations remain deterministic code-owned behavior.

views.purpose: Present completion, score, pass, distribution, and recent-result information in one glance.

session.expectation: Live datasource updates recompute the current dashboard without resetting or navigating.

rendering.rationale: The two landscape surfaces retain the same information hierarchy while flex tracks and type sizes reallocate available space.

motion.rationale: Operational results must remain stable for scanning; live values update without decorative transitions.

branding.provenance: The example uses only the fictional Northline Mobility label and generated semantic colors.
branding.fallback: Use the coordinated Dark preset when no customer branding direction is supplied.

settings.purpose: Minimum percentage counted as a pass.
Controls whether corporate IDs are visible on the shared display.
Selects the coordinated Dark, Light, or Custom palette.

dynamicText.fallback: Reduce to the declared readable minimum and preserve the complete title.
dynamicText.rationale: The primary operator-authored title must remain intact in both supported landscapes.

dynamicText.fallback: Ellipsize only the participant-name tail while preserving score, status, and timestamp columns.
dynamicText.rationale: Recent submissions remain aligned and scannable when identity labels vary.

states.expectation: The primary dashboard shows all KPIs, distribution bands, and six recent synthetic results without dead space.
The Light preset preserves hierarchy and complete metrics on the smaller supported landscape.
Optional identity detail remains contained and does not displace score or status columns.
A long operator-authored heading auto-fits without clipping or hiding adjacent live status.
A bound empty Results table shows a deliberate empty state rather than fictional sample data.
A direct row-array datasource shape normalizes to the same metrics and recent-result table.

behaviors.expectation: Synthetic rows produce the expected completion and pass-rate metrics.
A bound empty datasource remains empty and never falls back to packaged sample rows.
A live datasource update recomputes aggregate metrics without reloading the app.

visualDirection.summary: A paired industrial safety command board with strong numeric hierarchy and a restrained tabular audit trail rather than a generic chart-card dashboard.
signatureChoices: A compact four-metric strip gives the shift lead an immediate top-line reading.
A narrow score-profile rail balances the recent-result table and explains the aggregate without a chart dependency.
avoid: Decorative charts that obscure exact counts

visualReview.intent: A credible safety operations surface that can be understood in seconds and audited at closer range.
focus: Verify title, participant names, status labels, and descenders remain intact at both supported sizes.
Verify Dark, Light, and Custom palettes retain complete semantic contrast.
Verify all derived values agree with the packaged synthetic Results rows.
